1.consolidated_definition: Informal, sencillo. Sin formalidad, generalmente referido a la ropa que no es de vestir. Desvío semántico, usual. DRAE 2001: que sucede por casualidad, imprevisto. Por otro lado, Carlos Cabrera, gerente general de Hyatt Regency Cerromar, dijo que el hotel espera poder inaugurar su nueva área recreacional, que incluye piscina olímpica, jacuzzi y un restaurante casual entre la playa y la piscina (El Nuevo Día, 28-11-97)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Informal, simple. Sin formalidad, generalmente referido a la ropa que no es de vestir. Desvío semántico, usual. DRAE 2001: que sucede por casualidad, imprevisto.

That happens by chance, unexpected. On the other hand, Carlos Cabrera, General Manager of Hyatt Regency Cerromar, said that the hotel expects to be able to inaugurate its new recreational area, which includes an Olympic pool, a hot tub and a casual restaurant between the beach and the pool (El Nuevo Día, 28-11-97)

Informal, simple. Without formality, generally referring to clothing not worn for formal occasions. Semantic shift, usual. DRAE 2001: that happens by chance, unexpected.

Note: I translated "DRAE 2001" as it is a reference to the dictionary itself and its edition year.
